title: CERN for AI: A Theoretical Framework for Autonomous Simulation-Based Artificial Intelligence Testing and Alignment
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it is not a subject of its analysis. The focus is on a general, simulation-based theoretical framework for AI testing and alignment based on theories from social sciences, computer science, and other disciplines.
